title: An app designed to do what it says on the tin
body: The user design of this app is so well thought out, the design and interactivity is easy to navigate and it feels inspiring to use it alongside reading about the practice of forming and maintaining habits. I love making it part of my daily habit-building.
author: Millhouse4

title: Productivity
body: A great and useable app to define what you need to accomplish and to keep you on track.
author: Helen频道

title: The perfect digital habit tool!
body: The app is the perfect continuation from James Clear’s book, Atomic Habits. Atoms incorporates all of the practical advise James Clear proposes in his book, right into the app! It is very well built, has a wonderful aesthetic and works seamlessly. Really looking forward to using this app more and also using widgets from the app when they become available!
author: Jefferyirons

title: This app really works!
body: I had read James Clear’s book, so thought this app would be a great next step. Wow! He has thought of every possible way to make your habits stick. I love the way it helps you word your goals and update them along the way - goals evolve. The articles explain the science behind why and how we stick to - or don’t stick to goals. A fantastic app.
author: Cazpett
